source.subject: test: retain M128N128 CA NVFP4 cell

purpose.question: Can the two resident M128xN128 CTAs reuse activation A through L1 by changing only A copies to cp.async.ca while B and scales continue streaming through cp.async.cg?
purpose.answer: Yes, the A-only-CA M128xN128 variant is repeatably positive versus the frozen M64xN256 baseline and materially repairs the earlier M128xN128-CG regression, but it still misses the absolute native admission gate.
purpose.classification: retain as the fastest measured native test-only development cell; do not admit to production
purpose.production_route: unchanged hybrid direct-dequant plus cuBLASLt bridge

shape_and_topology.grid: 136 N tiles x 4 M tiles = 544 CTAs
shape_and_topology.weight_and_scale_cache_operator: packed B and scales retain cp.async.cg
shape_and_topology.scale_reuse: one K256 16-byte scale window per output row, retained for four K64 stages

sass_cache_operator_evidence.measurement: static LDGSTS instruction sites in the instantiated kernel SASS, not dynamic traffic

control_m128n128_cg.bypass_role: activation A, packed B, and scales

sass_cache_operator_evidence.conclusion: The compiled candidate changes only A to cache-all; B and scale traffic remains L1-bypassing as designed.

correctness_and_rejection_contract.independent_audit: pass with no blocking mapping, bounds, pipeline, cache-operator, scale-slot, epilogue, resource, Graph, or production-route findings

protocol.candidate: M128xN128 A-only cp.async.ca; B and scales cp.async.cg
protocol.pair_stop_loss: skip Gate+Up pair unless the single-Gate candidate clears both the positive-round and absolute-latency gates

aggregate.decision: retain test-only as a positive development cell; reject production admission

comparison_to_m128n128_cg.interpretation: A-only cache-all recovers the CG cell's doubled-A cache penalty, but does not make the M128 arithmetic body admissible.

screen_log.expected_exit: nonzero solely because the absolute candidate gate rejects the otherwise six-of-six positive cell

protocol.use: causal attribution only, not formal latency
protocol.warning: GPU caches and clocks were uncontrolled during profiling. The baseline is M64xN256-CG while the candidate is M128xN128-CA, so the counters also mix topology effects and cannot attribute the full delta to cp.async.ca. The report is directional evidence and the B-C-C-B screen remains authoritative for latency.

nsight_compute_comparison.interpretation: SASS proves that the compiled A-only cache operator converts the intended activation copies from bypass to cache-access. Relative to the M64xN256-CG control, the M128xN128-CA profile has 11.23% fewer L2 request bytes, 51.86% fewer bypass bytes, and lower duration, but those deltas include both cache-operator and tile-topology effects. The remaining lower issue activity and higher MIO throttle support closing further M128 arithmetic micro-tuning rather than claiming production readiness.

decision.candidate: positive test-only development cell, rejected from production admission
decision.retained_value: keep the implementation and frozen screen as evidence that A-only cp.async.ca is useful even though this M128 mapping misses the absolute gate
decision.m128n128_arithmetic_body: closed to further K128, deeper-pipeline, and micro-scheduling cells

next_bounded_cell.change: transfer only activation A copies from cp.async.cg to cp.async.ca while retaining B and scales on cp.async.cg
next_bounded_cell.reason: preserve the faster frozen M64 topology and its independent two-CTA phase progress while applying the one cache mechanism that produced six-of-six positive rounds

do_not_repeat: do not describe a positive relative screen as production admission when the absolute gate fails
do not run Gate+Up pair timing after the frozen single-Gate stop-loss
do not route MTP as a shortcut
